How group orders work

  1. Send a request with the product and quantity you want.
  2. We collect requests and confirm whether the group quantity can be reached.
  3. We contact you with the final price and an estimated delivery window before you decide.
  4. Pay a 50% deposit to confirm your order. The remaining 50% is due when you receive the product.

Important: A request is not a confirmed order. We will confirm the final product details, total price, delivery estimate, and order status with you first. Delivery times vary by product and destination; we will tell you the estimated number of days before you pay. The balance is payable upon receipt. Please inspect your item and contact us promptly if there is a problem.
